Hi Connor,

Thanks for the quick intro over LinkedIn last week — excited to get the onboarding started. We're preparing to run a SIG/CAIQ intake and we'd like to align on the evidence cadence and a short walk-through call this week. High level: SagePath is going through a vendor review for platform security and the procurement team has requested completed CAIQ + SIG artifacts and a short intake call to triage which evidence we can hand off vs. where Redwood will need to provide extracts (logs, key rotation records, etc.).

Attached is our baseline CAIQ export (SagePath_CAIC_Questionnaire_v1.pdf) — it's the set the procurement team wants completed. Can you confirm who on your side will own the evidence and whether Redwood can provide a log sample window for the request?

Proposed call times (all PDT):
- Tue Jul 6, 09:00–09:30
- Tue Jul 6, 14:00–14:30
- Wed Jul 7, 08:30–09:00

If none of those work we'll send a Calendly link. Also can you share your evidence matrix template so we can pre-fill what we can?

Best,

Head of Security Operations
SagePath

- Owners: Marissa (security intake lead) will run the CAIQ mapping and own the doc handoff. Ben (platform infra) will be the point for logs and retention questions. Grace (customer success) will own procurement cadence and any billing/contract asks. I'll host the intake call and triage the SIG questions.
- We use a simple evidence matrix that we can drop into your CAIQ — attaching the template: redwood_evidence_matrix_template.xlsx
- We can provide a 72-hour log sample window; Ben can confirm exact export timestamps on the call.

Suggested time from our side: Tue Jul 6 at 14:00 PDT (21:00 UTC). If that works, I'll send a calendar invite. Please confirm attendees and whether you prefer a short Q&A or a walkthrough style session.

Thanks — Connor

Hi all — quick post-call summary and action register (recording and attachments linked below). Thanks to the SagePath team for the prep — good meeting.

Summary of what we covered:
- Walkthrough of the CAIQ export and fields that map to Redwood artifacts (Marissa led).
- Logs: Ben confirmed Redwood can export the requested artefacts: request logs (tokenized request IDs), control plane audit logs, and host-level access logs for the 7-day window. Full exports require data export request (we'll deliver a scoped S3 transfer).
- Encryption & keys: Connor confirmed KMS integration details and that CMKs are rotated annually by default.
- SLA & retention: Grace to coordinate procurement cadence for a copy of the vendor questionnaire; Redwood to supply retention policy excerpts and sample retention labels.

3) Connor — pull KMS rotation policy snippet and provide a short writeup (due: 2026-07-09)
